title: Fire suppression system.
officialText:
In buildings that are equipped throughout with an automatic sprinkler system in accordance
with Section 903.3.1.1, plastic light-diffusing systems shall be protected both above and below unless the sprinkler system has
been specifically approved for installation only above the light-diffusing system. Areas of light-diffusing systems that are
protected in accordance with this section shall not be limited.
